000011|   const majorDocumentUrls=new Map();
000012|   function getMajorPdfUrl(document){
000013|     if(majorDocumentUrls.has(document.name))return majorDocumentUrls.get(document.name);
000014|     const raw=atob(document.data),chunks=[],limit=32768;
000015|     for(let i=0;i<raw.length;i+=limit){
000016|       const part=raw.slice(i,i+limit),bytes=new Uint8Array(part.length);
000017|       for(let j=0;j<part.length;j++)bytes[j]=part.charCodeAt(j);
000018|       chunks.push(bytes);
000019|     }
000020|     const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(chunks,{type:'application/pdf'}));
000021|     majorDocumentUrls.set(document.name,url);
000022|     return url;
000023|   }
